scenes.say: This eye problem steals your sight silently. No pain, no warning.

scenes.en: It slowly damages the optic nerve.
scenes.say: It's called glaucoma. It slowly damages the optic nerve, which carries what you see from the eye to the brain.

scenes.en: So most people don't notice it.
scenes.say: Side vision fades first, slowly, from the edges. So most people don't notice it until late.

scenes.en: If a parent or grandparent had it, your risk is higher.
scenes.say: If a parent or grandparent had glaucoma, your risk is higher. Age over forty and diabetes also raise the risk.

scenes.en: Finding it early helps protect your sight.
scenes.say: Vision lost to glaucoma does not come back. A full eye check looks at eye pressure, the optic nerve and side vision, to find it early.

scenes.en: Book a full eye check with an eye specialist.
scenes.say: So after forty, or with a family history, get a full eye check by an eye specialist. Book one for your parents today.
